The method operates on the standard 3D Gaussian representation.
**Identify Ambiguous Regions:** Scan the Gaussian cloud to locate boundaries between objects that share similar RGB colors.
**Evaluate Contribution:** For Gaussians identified at these ambiguous borders, evaluate their contribution to the rendering of the segmentation target.
**Gradient Analysis:** During the removal phase, the method relies on gradient signals.
**Removal:** Eliminate the ambiguous Gaussians.
